text.arabic_uthmani: فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative bounty, locally explaining the preceding acts as reason or manner and paired with blessing
words.root_gloss_range: bounty, surplus, beneficence, and rank or preference; the local maṣdar foregrounds bestowed bounty while keeping preference pressure narrowed and noncompetitive
words.prose: {{ar:فَضْلًا}} ({{tr:faḍlan}}) opens as an accusative explanation that reaches back to the prior divine acts in 49:7; it names those acts as bounty either by reason or by manner. Its indefinite maṣdar shape keeps the gift unbounded and above desert, while the {{ar:ف ض ل}} ({{tr:f-ḍ-l}}) range lets surplus and preferential distinction color the line without turning it into competition or an explicit ranking noun. The word also begins the gift-pair that will be balanced by the closing knowledge-wisdom pair.

topics.headline: opening accusative reaches back as reason or manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens by explaining the prior divine reshaping, while local grammar leaves reason and manner both viable.
topics.reason: The accusative has no local verb in 49:8 and is guarded as either purposive accusative or circumstantial, so the prose preserves the cross-ayah explanation without forcing one analysis.
topics.summary: The word functions as an initial explanatory accusative tied to 49:7 rather than as a new object inside 49:8.

topics.headline: indefinite bounty carries surplus and preference pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gift as unbounded bestowed surplus that can distinguish recipients, not as a wage or a competitive ranking term.
topics.reason: The surface maṣdar selects bounty and beneficence; V4 allows excess and rank branches, but local form blocks reciprocal vying or an explicit ranking noun.
topics.summary: Indefiniteness and root range keep the bounty open, qualitative, and above desert while narrowing rank language to latent differentiation.

topics.headline: bounty is paired with blessing and sealed by knowledge and wisdom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a balanced design: the received gift-pair is anchored to divine source and then interpreted by the knowledge-wisdom pair.
topics.reason: Local coordination with niʿmatan and the closing predicates support the structural movement from bounty to source, blessing, and attribute-ground.
topics.summary: The first word starts a compact gift beat that later answers to the final attribute beat.

words.gloss_range: source preposition governing the following divine name and anchoring the preceding bounty
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) makes the abstract bounty a source phrase: origin and causal derivation are routed from God rather than left as a vague association. The local governed proper name blocks a partitive reading, so the payoff is source, not portion. Its doubled nasal surface also makes the particle cling tightly to the following name, so the source relation is heard as one compact unit.

topics.headline: source min routes bounty from God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the bounty grammatically routed from God as origin and cause, while partitive or merely associative readings are blocked.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as a genitive source complement of faḍlan; local proper-name government blocks a partitive sense.
topics.summary: The particle supplies the source relation that prevents the opening bounty from remaining unattributed.

topics.headline: nasalized particle binds tightly to the source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the small particle as a tight bridge into the governed divine name, not as a detachable afterthought.
topics.reason: The written and recited surface binds mina to the following governed noun, matching its syntactic source function.
topics.summary: Surface fusion and postposed order make the source phrase arrive as the resolving anchor for the abstract bounty.

words.gloss_range: genitive proper divine name governed by the source preposition
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; local use fixes the single divine source, while derivational discussions may color worship, refuge, and awe without changing reference
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) is the named source inside the prepositional phrase, so the bounty is not assigned to an impersonal process or to the recipients themselves. As {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) evidence, the proper name carries divine identity and exclusivity, while local grammar keeps it genitive and dependent. The later nominative repetition turns the same referent from source into subject of the attribute seal.

topics.headline: proper divine name fixes the source of bounty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the source named as the definite divine identity itself, not as an impersonal process, social cause, or generic benefactor.
topics.reason: The proper name is locally the genitive object of mina; derivational pressures around the name may color worship and awe but do not change the referent.
topics.summary: The source phrase is theologically specific because it uses the proper divine name in genitive dependence.

topics.headline: same name moves from governed source to later subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same name first embedded as source and later reopened as the subject of the attribute clause.
topics.reason: The kasra-governed form is dependent on mina, while word 7 is nominative subject; the case alternation supports the source-to-characterization movement.
topics.summary: A small case change carries a large structural pivot inside the ayah.

topics.headline: divine source participates in gift and attribute formula fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the local source phrase as part of a broader Quranic pattern in which divine bounty is not human merit and is later grounded by knowledge and wisdom.
topics.reason: The local faḍl plus Allāh relation and repeated name align with the closing attribute pair without inventing a new sense for the proper name.
topics.summary: Formulaic source and attribute patterns converge around the repeated divine name.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the second accusative gift noun to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps niʿmatan coordinated with faḍlan, so blessing is a second facet of the same explanatory gift beat rather than a replacement gloss. The particle therefore preserves both the surplus side of bounty and the experienced well-being side of blessing. Because it is proclitic in recitation, the connection is also heard as a smooth carry into the second noun.

topics.headline: conjunction preserves two gift facets
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees blessing added as a second coordinated facet, not as an appositional replacement for bounty.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates niʿmatan with faḍlan under the same accusative frame, preserving both gift terms.
topics.summary: The particle makes the first beat a two-term gift pair: surplus bounty plus experienced blessing.

topics.headline: attached waw carries the line into blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears continuity into the second gift noun while still recognizing it as an independent accusative term.
topics.reason: The proclitic surface attaches to niʿmatan, supporting recited continuity without erasing coordination.
topics.summary: The surface flow joins the two nouns without collapsing their distinct roles.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative blessing coordinated with bounty as a present instance of favor
words.root_gloss_range: favor, blessing, softness, ease, and bestowed well-being; local noun selects a concrete blessing instance, not enduring bliss or unrelated derivative branches
words.prose: {{ar:نِعْمَةً}} ({{tr:niʿmatan}}) shares the accusative explanatory frame with the opening bounty, so it too reaches back to the divine reshaping described in 49:7. Through {{ar:ن ع م}} ({{tr:n-ʿ-m}}), the word adds felt ease and softened condition to the objective surplus of faḍl; the local noun keeps this as a present blessing instance rather than an enduring bliss-state. It also completes the gift pair that the final attributes will calibrate.

topics.headline: second accusative shares the boundary-spanning role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that blessing inherits the same explanatory reach back to 49:7 instead of starting a new sentence.
topics.reason: Case matching and coordination bind niʿmatan to faḍlan as a second accusative within the same reason or manner frame.
topics.summary: The blessing term participates in the same cross-ayah explanatory syntax as the opening bounty.

topics.headline: blessing names a felt conferred state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gift not only as objective surplus but as a softened lived condition granted to recipients.
topics.reason: The local noun selects a present blessing instance; root branches of softness, ease, and bestowal color it, while enduring bliss-state and remote concrete derivatives are kept narrowed.
topics.summary: Niʿma supplies the experiential side of the gift pair: livable ease conferred, not an eschatological state or merely abstract approval.

topics.headline: blessing is paired with bounty and framed by divine knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first gift pair prepared for the final attribute pair, so pleasant blessing is calibrated by knowledge and wisdom.
topics.reason: The direct coordination with faḍlan and the following attribute closure support a structure in which blessing and bounty are interpreted together.
topics.summary: The word completes the gift beat before the ayah pivots to divine characterization.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the closing nominal clause while preserving connection
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the ayah hinge: it connects back to the gift phrase but, because the next word is nominative, it opens a new nominal sentence rather than a third accusative. The payoff is not mere addition; the line pivots from the experienced effect to the divine attributes that ground it. Its fused surface with the repeated name makes the reset visible and recitable at once.

topics.headline: waw pivots from gift effect to divine ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a hinge: the line stays connected to the gift phrase but restarts as a nominative attribute sentence.
topics.reason: Local syntax favors resumptive istiʾnāf because the following name is nominative subject, though the particle still carries connection rather than pure separation.
topics.summary: The second conjunction marks both continuity and reset, moving from received bounty to the Giver-characterization that grounds it.

topics.headline: proclitic waw makes the reset visible in wa-llāhu
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the transition in one fused surface unit: connection is attached directly to the repeated divine name.
topics.reason: The written wa-llāhu form packages the hinge particle with the nominative subject while case signals a new clause.
topics.summary: The surface lets recitation move smoothly even as grammar opens a new nominal sentence.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine subject of the closing nominal clause
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; local use selects the attribute-bearing subject and links it back to the earlier source occurrence
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) repeats the divine name as a full nominative subject instead of a pronoun, giving the closure lexical weight. The same {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) referent has moved from governed source to attribute-bearing subject, so the giver is now characterized by standing knowledge and wisdom. One stated subject controls both predicates, making the formula a stable ground for the gift rather than a new event.

topics.headline: explicit nominative subject governs two predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one explicit subject bearing both knowledge and wisdom as standing predicates, not two loose descriptors.
topics.reason: The nominative subject and two nominative predicates form a complete nominal clause with one mubtadaʾ and two khabars.
topics.summary: The repeated name gives the attribute seal a full subject rather than a light pronoun.

topics.headline: source becomes characterized divine identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Giver is no longer only source of bounty but the named bearer of stable knowledge and wisdom.
topics.reason: The proper name is now nominative and attribute-bearing; derivational pressures may color worship and awe but remain subordinate to the local subject role.
topics.summary: The ayah moves from origin to characterization through the same repeated divine name.

topics.headline: Allāh plus knowledge and wisdom forms the closing ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the closing formula as explaining why the gift is rightly allocated: knowledge grounds wise action.
topics.reason: The local sequence realizes the recurring Allāh plus ʿalīm plus ḥakīm formula and specializes it to the preceding bounty and blessing.
topics.summary: The subject anchors the formula that turns the specific gift into a broader divine rule.

words.gloss_range: indefinite faʿīl qualitative adjective as the first predicate: all-knowing, comprehensively knowing
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, marking, and the domain of what is knowable; local form selects abiding knowledge, with marking and world-range as narrowing color rather than separate senses
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:ʿalīmun}}) is the first predicate of the repeated divine subject, so knowledge is the first stated ground for the bounty and blessing. Its {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) field gives more than ordinary awareness: the faʿīl form presents abiding comprehensive knowledge, while the marking image makes that knowledge discerning enough to place the gift exactly. The word also answers the human know-command of 49:7 with divine knowing already established.

topics.headline: first predicate begins a directly stacked pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge stated first and directly stacked before wisdom, giving the attribute order its own logic.
topics.reason: The adjective is the first predicate of Allāh and stands beside the second predicate without an intervening conjunction.
topics.summary: Knowledge is the first ground for the preceding bounty before wise judgment lands the seal.

topics.headline: faʿīl knowledge is comprehensive and discerning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names abiding comprehensive knowing that distinguishes the right place of bounty, not instruction or acquired learning here.
topics.reason: The faʿīl qualitative adjective supports durable intensive knowledge; marking and world-domain images can color discernment and scope, while teaching and learning processes are not locally selected.
topics.summary: The root field gives divine knowledge precision and breadth, but local morphology keeps it an attribute rather than a teaching event.

topics.headline: divine knowing answers human knowing and pairs with wisdom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader catches the epistemic asymmetry: humans are commanded to know in 49:7, while God is already described by intensive knowing in 49:8.
topics.reason: Same-surah and co-occurrence evidence supports the local divine-knowledge field, especially as paired with ḥakīm.
topics.summary: The word links the boundary movement from commanded human knowing to asserted divine knowledge.

words.gloss_range: indefinite faʿīl qualitative adjective as the second predicate: wise, decisive in judgment
words.root_gloss_range: wisdom, judgment, restraint, ruling, and firm ordering; local form selects enduring wise judgment, with restraint and firmness as controlled image pressure
words.prose: {{ar:حَكِيمٌ}} ({{tr:ḥakīmun}}) is the second parallel predicate, not a modifier of knowledge, and its final position lands the ayah on wise judgment. Through {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}), wisdom includes judgment, restraint, and firm ordering, so the closing attribute explains the bounty as precisely governed rather than arbitrary. The doubled faʿīl cadence with ʿalīmun makes knowledge and wisdom both semantic and acoustic closure.

topics.headline: second predicate completes the balanced attribute seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees wisdom as a second standing predicate under the same subject, giving the ayah its final landing.
topics.reason: The word matches ʿalīmun in nominative indefinite faʿīl form and is the second predicate, not a modifier of the first.
topics.summary: The final word completes the directly paired knowledge-wisdom closure.

topics.headline: wisdom includes judgment, restraint, and firm ordering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final wisdom is active governance and precise placement, not abstract contemplation only.
topics.reason: V4 supports judgment, wisdom, restraint, and firmness branches; the local faʿīl adjective selects enduring wise judgment while bridle and firmness images remain metaphorical pressure.
topics.summary: The root range makes the closing attribute govern the allocation of bounty with controlled, firm judgment.

topics.headline: final wisdom governs the gift and resolves the command-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the specific bounty generalized: divine wisdom explains its allocation and resolves the prior command-domain tension.
topics.reason: The local closure links faḍl with ḥakīm and boundary evidence from 49:7, making wise governance the final interpretive landing.
topics.summary: The ayah ends by placing the received gift under divine wise judgment as a broader rule.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَضْلًا and نِعْمَةً at words 1 and 4, sourced to Allah and closed by عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The excess and voluntary-bounty branches of فضل feed the bestowed-good-condition branch of نعمة: an unowed surplus crosses from giver to recipient and becomes livable well-being. عليم and حكيم make the transfer fitted and firm rather than random overflow or earned wage.

activation_trace.role: Excess and remainder supply the literal surplus from which the gift can proceed.
Voluntary beneficence turns surplus into an unowed transfer to another.
Bestowed favor and pleasant condition supply the recipient-side result of the transfer.
Knowledge as clear apprehension makes the giver's fitting of the benefit non-accidental.
Making firm and complete supplies the wise completion of surplus as stable good.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that blessing comes from Allah, followed by two familiar attributes.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately fitted surplus, owed to no one, is converted into the recipient's good condition and made firm by knowing wisdom.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَضْلًا at word 1 together with عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ at words 6-7.
baseline_models.mechanism: فضل holds rank and virtue beside the impulse to claim superiority. The following knowledge and adjudication relocate the authority to distinguish rank: excellence can be granted and known, but cannot be secured by the recipient's own comparative claim.

activation_trace.role: Rank, virtue, and comparative excellence supply the positive distinction at issue.
Claiming superiority supplies the unstable counterfeit of granted excellence.
Clear knowledge locates reliable recognition of merit with Allah rather than the claimant.
Adjudication among people supplies the authority that settles competing rank claims.

changed_reading.before: فضل denotes a favorable gift or elevated status.
changed_reading.after: The ayah holds true excellence and self-exalting comparison apart: distinction is a grant under divine knowledge and judgment, not a possession certified by its claimant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نِعْمَةً, عَلِيمٌ, and حَكِيمٌ at words 4, 6, and 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gift has an embodied texture: نعمة softens, علم marks and orients, and حكم restrains like a bridle. Softness and restraint are complementary, producing a disposition receptive enough to be guided but bounded enough not to run toward corruption.

activation_trace.role: Softness and ease supply the changed texture of the recipient's condition.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies orientation made legible in the recipient.
Restraint for repair supplies the corrective boundary around the softened disposition.
The literal bridle-piece gives the restraint model its embodied governing image.

changed_reading.before: نعمة is a pleasant benefit, while عليم حكيم simply praise its giver.
changed_reading.after: Favor is a governed disposition: softened enough to receive, marked enough to orient, and bridled enough to avoid destructive motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening vertical sequence reverses ordinary rank display. Not moving ahead, not lifting one's voice, actively lowering it, and undergoing inward refinement make فضل visible as relinquished precedence. حكيم's bridle is enacted socially before it is named in the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Rank and elevation supply the focus model that the opening sequence turns upside down.
The bridle-piece supplies the focus image for deliberate self-restraint.
Advancing and taking precedence supply the first vertical motion to be withheld.
Literal elevation of voice makes status display audible rather than merely abstract.
Holding back and lowering by reduction supplies the counter-motion to self-elevation.
Refinement after testing turns lowered behavior into an inwardly formed capacity.

structural_cues: 49:1-3 moves from prohibited precedence, through prohibited vocal elevation, to lowered voice and refined heart; outer verticality becomes inward formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the advance, elevation, lowering, and refinement sequence; I infer that this relinquished precedence is one realized form of 49:8's فضل and wise restraint. A live alternative is that these are etiquette conditions preceding, but not constituting, the gift.

changed_reading.before: Divine favor may confer rank while wisdom restrains its misuse.
changed_reading.after: The conferred excellence appears paradoxically as the capacity not to go first or sound higher; rank is manifested by disciplined de-escalation.

context_deltas.mechanism: فضل's surplus becomes a margin inside action: an arriving report is not allowed to pass directly into impact. Disclosure occupies the margin, while حكيم restrains the disturbance of ignorance before it hardens into irreversible regret.

activation_trace.role: Excess and remainder supply a spare margin between reception and reaction.
Corrective restraint supplies the blocking function within that margin.
An arriving, transmitted report supplies the input that could otherwise trigger action immediately.
Appearance and disclosure supply the verification stage that fills the buffer.
Impulsive disturbance and lack of forbearance supply the dangerous acceleration the buffer checks.
Regret over what has passed supplies the irreversible downstream state that verification prevents.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders report, verification, possible injury, completed action, and regret as an explicit temporal chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered report-to-regret chain; I supply the buffer metaphor and identify its interruption with فضل's surplus plus حكيم's restraint. The live alternative is that 49:6 only exemplifies prudence and does not define the favor named in 49:8.

changed_reading.before: فضل is additional benefit given to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: فضل can be additional decision-space: the gifted interval in which a report becomes clear before ignorance can become harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gift moves inside valuation. Faith is made heart-adhering and visibly beautiful, while disbelief, fissure, and disobedience become affectively repellent; the resulting path is straightened from within. نعمة's softness and حكيم's bridle therefore cooperate through desire rather than external compulsion.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary beneficence identifies the inward repatterning as an unowed divine act.
Softening supplies the receptive texture in which attraction and aversion can be re-formed.
The bridle image supplies governance through directed inclination rather than brute blockage.
Heart-settling assent supplies the state toward which desire is reoriented.
Love adhering to the heart supplies the attractive force of the mechanism.
Making beauty manifest supplies perceptual salience to what the heart has been made to love.
Repellent aversion supplies the opposing force that makes destructive options unattractive.
A straight path away from error supplies the directional outcome of the affective forces.

structural_cues: 49:7 pairs endearment and beautification with induced aversion, ends in right direction, and is followed immediately by 49:8's two gift nouns.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the affective operations and their directional result; I infer that 49:8 retrospectively names this desire architecture as فضل and نعمة. A live alternative is that 49:8 names a reward or source generally rather than the operations themselves.

changed_reading.before: Favor improves the recipient's condition and wisdom restrains bad movement.
changed_reading.after: The favor is the changed wanting itself: faith becomes lovable and legible, rebellion becomes distasteful, and wise restraint works as an inward vector toward sound direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: حكيم's restraint becomes a reversible social controller. Transgression crosses a limit, force is applied only until return, estrangement is then removed, and balance re-tethers the parties as kin. نعمة is not conflict avoidance but the preserved possibility of return and repaired relation after force.

activation_trace.role: Restraint that turns back corruption supplies the controller's corrective purpose.
Turning back supplies the focus-side reversibility later made explicit in conflict.
Bestowed good condition supplies repaired social well-being as the process's end.
Crossing the limit through aggression supplies the deviation requiring correction.
Returning and turning back supply the stop condition for coercive force.
Removing estrangement supplies repair both before escalation and after return.
Setting a thing upright supplies post-conflict rebalancing rather than mere cessation.
The straight balance supplies the calibration criterion for repaired relations.
A tether or binding supplies the relation that equitable repair restores.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeats repair on both sides of a bounded fight-until-return clause, then 49:10 redescribes the parties as siblings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limit-crossing, bounded force, return, repeated repair, balance, and kinship; I infer the feedback-control direction and identify its recoverability as نعمة under حكيم. A live alternative is that the focus gift remains only the inward guidance of 49:7 while 49:9-10 applies its effects independently.

changed_reading.before: Wisdom restrains corruption and favor yields a good condition.
changed_reading.after: Wise favor preserves reversibility: force is bounded by return, return reopens repair, and repair restores a balanced social bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possibility that the mocked person is better makes peer ranking opaque at the moment ridicule pretends to settle it. فضل's virtue branch remains live, but its superiority-claim branch becomes socially dangerous; حكيم's adjudication withholds rank from mockery, fault-marking, and hostile naming.

activation_trace.role: Comparative virtue supplies the real but not socially transparent difference under dispute.
Claiming superiority supplies the posture enacted by ridicule.
Adjudication supplies the authority peers lack when they rank one another through contempt.
Mocking laughter supplies the performative assertion of another's lower rank.
Excellence through soundness and selection supplies the hidden reversal: the target may outrank the mocker.
Faulting by a pointed mark supplies the mechanism by which a peer tries to fix another's identity.

structural_cues: 49:11 repeats the possibility that the derided party is better, turning ridicule into an epistemically unstable rank claim.
The reciprocal nicknaming and epithet construction at 49:11 words 27-28 uses roots ن ب ز and ل ق ب only as branchless structural cues; no mapped root or branch identifier is assigned to either.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ridicule, fault-marking, and the explicit possibility of reversed merit; I infer that these expose فضل's self-superiority branch as a counterfeit of its virtue branch. A live alternative is that the passage regulates speech without revising the focus concept of فضل.

changed_reading.before: True rank is divinely known rather than self-certified.
changed_reading.after: Rank becomes ethically dangerous when performed between peers: the very target fixed as lesser may be better, so divine فضل cannot be weaponized as a social label.

context_deltas.mechanism: عليم no longer implies that humans should maximize information. Suspicion produces unstable pseudo-knowledge, covert tracking tries to penetrate what is absent, and backbiting converts absence into consumable social matter. حكيم's bridle makes finite non-knowing a gift, while the final divine seeing leaves no informational deficit to be repaired by intrusion.

activation_trace.role: Clear knowledge supplies the divine completeness against which human conjecture is measured.
The bridle supplies a deliberate limit on the human drive to know and disclose.
Doubt and imagining supply a low-grade substitute for knowledge that can masquerade as certainty.
Secretly tracking reports supplies the invasive attempt to close the uncertainty.
Speaking of a person in absence supplies the conversion of hiddenness into exploitable social material.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain human intrusion cannot exhaust.
Insight of the heart supplies the closing divine perception that makes intrusive supplementation unnecessary.

structural_cues: 49:12 moves from conjecture to covert search to speech about the absent, then materializes the sequence as eating a dead sibling's flesh; 49:18 closes the surah with divine knowledge of the unseen and sight of action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escalating conjecture, intrusion, absent-person speech, and final divine perception; I infer that wise restraint protects a finite knower from trying to imitate divine informational reach. A live alternative is that the prohibitions concern privacy and honor without making non-knowing itself a نعمة.

changed_reading.before: عليم حكيم assures that the giver fully knows how to distribute favor.
changed_reading.after: One form of knowing wisdom is a protected limit: humans are spared the need to turn suspicion and hiddenness into invasive certainty because divine knowledge already encompasses what action requires.

context_deltas.mechanism: فضل as distinction survives the critique of peer ranking by changing function. Created differences become signs for reciprocal recognition, while honor is relocated to self-protective conduct whose interior reality is known and probed by Allah. Difference is retained as legibility but blocked from becoming domination.

activation_trace.role: Comparative distinction supplies the focus category whose social function is revised.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies difference as legibility rather than superiority.
Recognition and discrimination by a trace or sign supply the reciprocal purpose of plurality.
Praiseworthy honor and generosity supply the rank term that must be relocated.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the conduct by which honor is measured.
Disclosure to the knower reserves the final reading of inward rank to Allah.
Knowledge of a report's interior supplies depth beyond visible group markers.

structural_cues: 49:13 orders common creation, differentiated peoples and tribes, reciprocal recognition, a new honor criterion, and divine interior knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created plurality, recognition, honor, protection, and interior knowledge; I infer that difference is preserved for recognition while comparative worth is transferred away from visible grouping. A live alternative is that 49:13 only corrects the criterion of rank and does not activate علم's mark branch in 49:8.

changed_reading.before: Divine فضل grants a rank that humans cannot reliably claim.
changed_reading.after: The favor permits visible differences to guide mutual recognition without carrying moral superiority; honor attaches instead to protective conduct whose depth Allah knows.

context_deltas.mechanism: نعمة's remote affirmation branch is activated by the split between saying faith and faith entering the heart. The gifted 'yes' is not a verbal token: it crosses inward, settles beyond doubt, and then externalizes as strenuous expenditure of wealth and self. Favor moves through a claim rather than stopping at it.

activation_trace.role: Answering yes and affirming supply the surprising focus-side pole of professed assent.
Unowed beneficence makes inward entry a received capacity rather than a self-authored claim.
Assent in which the heart settles supplies the state that speech alone has not yet reached.
Handing over and relinquishing supply an outer submission that can exist before inward settlement.
Literal entry supplies the crossing from utterance into interior state.
The heart supplies the interior destination rather than a metaphorically unspecified inside.
Agitated doubt supplies the instability absent after assent has settled inwardly.
Exerting full capacity under difficulty supplies the outward pressure test of inward assent.
Possessed and accumulated wealth supplies one store through which settled assent spends itself.
The very self supplies the second and less detachable store placed into action.
Fulfilling a claim through action supplies the closure that distinguishes truth from utterance.

structural_cues: 49:14 contrasts a spoken claim with faith not yet entering hearts; 49:15 then sequences settled belief, absence of doubt, and costly action.
The no-diminution clause at 49:14 word 20 uses root ل ي ت only as a branchless structural cue for preservation; no mapped root or branch identifier is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim, surrender, inward entry, settled confidence, expenditure, and enacted truth; I infer a claim-to-interior-to-action flow and use نعمة's affirmation branch as its latent bridge. The live alternative is that the affirmation branch is only formal wordplay and should not shape the lexical reading of نعمة here.

changed_reading.before: نعمة is bestowed favor, with an etymologically remote possibility of affirmation.
changed_reading.after: The favor is an effective yes that does not remain speech: it enters the heart, survives doubt, and verifies itself by spending wealth and self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence makes مِنَ ٱللَّهِ an anti-credit operator. Human beings cannot inform Allah of their religion or invoice the messenger for their submission; the reminder that burdens a beneficiary is reversed, and guidance appears as gentle direction released without countervalue. Knowledge of hidden and visible action closes every route by which self-report might seize authorship.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary bounty supplies a transfer that is not payment for the recipient's prior merit.
Bestowed favor supplies the benefit whose authorship is being contested.
Complete apprehension supplies the reason recipient self-report cannot add missing information.
The teach-know-knowing repetition makes the failed attempt to inform Allah structurally explicit.
Burdening a beneficiary by recounting a favor supplies the human attempt to create divine debt.
Release without compensation supplies the opposed divine mode of giving.
Gentle indication toward the true road supplies the concrete content of the unpriced gift.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the domain already encompassed without recipient testimony.
Direct sight supplies the observation of action that defeats self-authored accounting.

structural_cues: 49:16-18 moves from trying to tell Allah about religion, through a threefold reversal of who confers favor, to divine knowledge of the unseen and sight of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed divine instruction, reciprocal favor-claim language, guidance, and comprehensive perception; I infer an accounting reversal in which مِنَ ٱللَّهِ cancels the recipient's invoice. A live alternative is that منّ simply marks benefaction on both sides and the anti-ledger force belongs only to the immediate rebuke.

changed_reading.before: فضل and نعمة are unowed benefits whose source is Allah.
changed_reading.after: Their divine source actively reverses the credit ledger: submission cannot make Allah debtor, guidance is released without price, and complete knowledge prevents self-report from reclaiming authorship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates نعمة's remote soft south-wind image and treats communal sound as an atmosphere; it remains anchored in focus word 4 and in the packet's audible voice, lowering, and self-holding branches. Render only as a material analogy for favor's operation, never as the lexical translation of نِعْمَةً.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نِعْمَةً at word 4 through its soft, moist south-wind branch, coordinated with the focus's wise-restraint model.

activation_trace.role: The literal soft, moist south wind supplies favor as a gently changing medium rather than a possessed object.
Audible sound supplies the communal medium whose harsh amplitude can be changed.
Lowering by deliberate reduction supplies the damping action of the soft current.
Holding the self against agitation supplies the sustained stillness in which the voice field settles.

changed_reading.before: Favor is something bestowed on individuals.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, favor is also a soft current through a social soundscape, damping competitive loudness until patient receptivity becomes possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from نعمة into its livestock and ostrich-scattering branches, then reads reconciliation as anti-dispersal; it remains anchored in focus word 4 and in branch-backed repair and tether images. Render as an ecological image of cohesion after conflict, not as a claim that نِعْمَةً denotes a flock here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نِعْمَةً at word 4 through its grazing-herd and ostrich-flight scattering branches.

activation_trace.role: Grazing livestock supply the collective body vulnerable to loss of cohesion.
The ostrich-flight image supplies rout and scattering as the threatened social state.
Removing estrangement supplies the anti-scattering action after conflict.
The literal tether supplies restored cohesion rather than mere spatial regrouping.

changed_reading.before: نعمة is the repaired good condition achieved after conflict.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, نعمة is anti-scattering energy: estranged parties are gathered from rout and re-tethered into a viable collective.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines فضل's garment branch, علم's guiding-mark branch, and a non-dominant split-root mark inventory behind the context's name word; it remains anchored in focus words 1 and 6 and exact 49:11 citations. Render as a counter-label material analogy, explicitly qualifying the split-root and garment distance, not as a direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَضْلًا at word 1 as a wrapping garment and عَلِيمٌ at word 6 as a distinguishing, guiding mark.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping in a garment supplies a received covering that can counter a socially imposed identity.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the focus's alternative mode of making a person legible.
Faulting by a pointed mark supplies the hostile inscription imposed by peers.
The split-root image of a visible mark making something known supplies naming as social inscription.

changed_reading.before: Divine favor benefits and divine knowledge identifies the recipient.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, favor reclothes the person beneath hostile peer inscriptions, while divine knowledge reads a guiding mark that ridicule and labels cannot author.

strongest_changes: 49:7 turns فضل and نعمة from external benefits into an affective reconfiguration that makes faith lovable, rebellion repellent, and right direction internally available.
49:9-10 turns حكيم's restraint into reversible conflict control whose endpoint is equitable re-tethering, not victory or permanent exclusion.
49:11-13 splits visible difference from moral rank: labels and ridicule cannot certify فضل, while plurality can still function as signs for reciprocal recognition.
49:16-18 turns مِنَ ٱللَّهِ into an anti-credit relation: guidance is released without price, recipient boasting is reversed, and comprehensive divine knowledge blocks self-authored accounting.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaved less like a closing commendation than a compact mechanism label. Its branch pairs generated several coexisting readings: surplus as decision-space, softness joined to bridle-like restraint, rank without self-exaltation, finite non-knowing as protection, and gift as an anti-ledger. Remote material branches also retained live but contained wind, flock, garment, tether, and mark images.
remaining_uncertainties: The strongest affective reading depends on taking 49:8's gift nouns as retrospective naming of 49:7's operations rather than a general source or reward statement.
The verification-buffer and protected-non-knowing models are causal extensions from فضل and حكيم, not explicit directional claims in the focus syntax.
The affirmation, soft-wind, livestock-scattering, garment, and split-root mark activations are branch-distant and should coexist as exploratory images rather than lexical replacements.
The rank, conflict-control, epistemic-boundary, and anti-credit readings reinforce one another but remain functionally distinct and should not be merged into a single consensus paraphrase.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Grace supplies surplus capacity for the prior transformation.** ف ض ل B001 ("excess and remainder") and B003 (beneficence) join ن ع م B001/B002 (bestowed favor; softness and easeful living). The grammatical fragment depends on 49:7's inward cultivation. I infer that guidance requires capacity beyond what the recipients generate, and that this surplus softens an otherwise rugged course. *Faḍl* reads as enabling remainder, not decorative abundance.
2. **Soft gift is paired with firm restraint.** ن ع م B002 gives softness, while ح ك م B001 (restraining to set right) and B004 (making firm and decisive) give structure. The packet juxtaposes favor with *ḥakīm*; I infer that the gift's ease is effective because it is bounded and directed. Wisdom is the bridle of grace, not its opposite.
3. **The giver knows the interior fit of the gift.** ع ل م B001 is clear knowledge and B002 a distinguishing mark; ن ع م B011 is "a place agreeing with someone." The ayah supplies divine knowledge and favor; I infer that the favor is fitted to the marked condition of its recipients. The close reads as discriminating placement rather than indiscriminate largesse.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The balancing intervention of 49:9 showed how ح ك م B001 restraint can operationalize beneficence. 49:17's reversal of human and divine favor then clarified that the surplus here is received capacity, not credit the recipients can claim.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The source of excellence blocks its conversion into a status claim.** `ف ض ل:B003` is voluntary bounty and beneficence, grounded in `ف ض ل:B001` as surplus beyond what is required. Yet `ف ض ل:B002` also carries comparative rank, and `ف ض ل:B004` the human claim to superiority. The window later dismantles status assertions through equal brotherhood (49:10), the possibility that the mocked are better (49:11), and honor measured by protective caution rather than grouping (49:13). The packet gives bounty and competing rank branches; I infer that **مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ** redirects all excellence from self-claim to received surplus. The verse therefore disarms boasting precisely while naming a distinction.

2. **Favor softens the interior, while wisdom supplies its restraining form.** `ن ع م:B001` is bestowed favor and good condition; `ن ع م:B002` adds softness and ease. `ح ك م:B001`, by contrast, is restraint that turns back injustice or folly to set it right, and `ح ك م:B004` is firmness and decisiveness. The sequence from hearts made to love and hate in 49:7 to regulated force in 49:9 and speech controls in 49:11–12 activates a complementary mechanism. The packet gives softness, restraint, and those applications; I infer that grace makes the heart tractable while wisdom gives that tractability a stable boundary. **نِعْمَةً ... حَكِيمٌ** thus names tender formation joined to firm governance.

3. **Divine wisdom anticipates adjudication, not abstract cleverness.** `ع ل م:B001` is knowledge as clear apprehension, while `ح ك م:B002` is just judgment among people and `ح ك م:B003` is hitting truth through knowledge and reason. The very next ayah requires intervention, differentiated force, return, justice, and equity between two groups. The packet supplies the adjective and its later procedural enactment; I infer that the closing pair guarantees that the affective ordering of 49:7 is fitted to real disputes. The verse reads as the epistemic and judicial ground of the conflict protocol that follows.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 49:13 and 49:17 confirm the branch tension: divine `ف ض ل:B003` produces excellence, whereas human `ف ض ل:B004` and `م ن ن:B003` turn received good into superiority or leverage. The terse ayah is therefore a prophylactic against the boasting that closes the surah.

baseline.text: Bu, Allah'tan bir lütuf ve nimettir. Allah da bilendir, hikmet sahibidir.

findings.text: Lütuf, önceki içsel dönüşümü alıcının kendi gücünü aşarak mümkün kılan ve gerekenden fazla verilen bir kapasitedir.
Lütfun Allah'tan oluşu, insandaki üstünlüğün övünme ve statü talebine çevrilmesini daha baştan geçersiz kılar.
Nimetin yumuşatıcı etkisi ile hikmetin sınırlayıp sağlamlaştıran etkisi, şefkatli oluşum ile kararlı yönetimi birlikte kurar.
Hikmet burada soyut zekâdan çok, hemen sonraki çatışmada doğru sınır, hüküm ve denge kurabilecek bilgili yargıdır.
Verilen nimetin alıcının iç durumuna uygun yerleştirildiği okuma, bilginin ayırt edici işaret ve uygun yer anlamlarından türeyen sınırlı bir ek boyuttur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: public affair or circumstance `quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`; binding command `quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`; authority and office `quranic:root_000051:B003/m01`; obedience as religion `quranic:root_000504:B001/m01`; city organized by obedience to authority `quranic:root_000504:B006/m01`; delegated judgment `quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`; governing care and maintenance `quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`; effective sovereign hand `quranic:root_001693:B005/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: affair, command, and authority occur at 49:7 and 9; wisdom/judgment at 49:8; people and governing care at 49:6 and 11; religion at 49:16; the hand root at 49:1.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Authority is not only a superior voice. It is an institutional scene with an affair to manage, command to issue, judgment to delegate, and community to maintain. The city image gives obedience a social architecture in which order depends on care as well as enforceable direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Fractured relations are restored by stopping violence, rejoining separated parts, and setting the whole to a just line and measure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social repair takes material form as patching a vessel, draining a wound, setting a bone, hearing a grievance, balancing a load, and weaving kinship tissue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Entrusting the Grievance to a Wise Arbiter
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An injured party presents a grievance to a delegated judge whose knowledge produces a firm and equitable decision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: judicial decision between people `quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`; wisdom that reaches the right judgment `quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`; firm and secured decision `quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`; delegated arbitration `quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`; grievance seeking redress `quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`; justice `quranic:root_000991:B001/m01`; equitable dealing `quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: wisdom and judgment occur at 49:8; justice and equity at 49:9; grievance/wrongdoing at 49:11.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Settlement requires a competent decision-maker, not only willing parties. The grievance supplies the claim, delegated authority supplies jurisdiction, wisdom identifies the right outcome, and firmness prevents the decision from dissolving under renewed pressure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human plurality is formed from one measured origin and becomes socially legible through faces, signs, group structure, and names.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same social world can be born through one womb, assembled as fitted branches, made familiar through encounter, or damaged when mockery and hostile labels manufacture distance and reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mockery as Social Subjugation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A mocker assumes superior standing, reduces another to an instrument or unpaid subordinate, and judges worth without knowing who is better.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: subjugating a thing for one's use `quranic:root_000685:B001/m01`; forced labor without wage `quranic:root_000685:B002/m01`; ridicule and mockery `quranic:root_000685:B003/m01`; beneficial good `quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`; selected excellence `quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`; choosing what is better `quranic:root_000452:B003/m01`; claiming superiority `quranic:root_001163:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: benefit and patient waiting occur at 49:5; distinction at 49:8; mockery and the possibility of the other's being better occur at 49:11.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mockery is a hierarchy-making act. Its same-root senses show the inferior treated as usable or exploitable, while the comparative-good senses expose the mocker's lack of grounds for selection. The scene reframes ridicule as an unauthorized assignment of rank and role.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Favor Arrives as Gift
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Benefit is handed over as blessing, guidance, distinction, or a gift whose source lies outside the recipient.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: unowed gift or favor `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`; blessing `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`; favor placed in another's hand `quranic:root_001693:B003/m01`; guidance as a gift `quranic:root_001583:B004/m01`; gift offered with hope of return `quranic:root_001294:B008/m01`; bestowing good `quranic:root_001449:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: distinction and blessing occur at 49:8; the hand root at 49:1; honor/gift at 49:13; gift-like guidance and bestowal at 49:17.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Favor is a transfer before it is a possession. Hand, gift, blessing, and guidance identify a giver-recipient relation, while the gift that seeks return reveals how easily transfer can become exchange. The scene keeps received guidance from being redescribed as self-generated merit.

facets.statement: Çekirdek eylem, giysinin uçlarını omuz çevresinde düzenleyip bedene dolayarak kuşanmaktır.
Erkek veya kadının özellikle ev içinde tek giysiyle bulunması, kuşanma biçiminin kişi ve mekâna bağlı görünümüdür.
Erkeğin gömlek ve üstlük giyip alt bedende ayrı bir örtü ya da pantolon giymemiş olması başka bir giyim düzeni olarak verilir.
Tek giysinin kendisi, kadın ve erkeğe göre kullanılan giysi adları ve bu kuşanışın güzel görünmesi dalın özel adlandırmalarıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.

Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه نعم التي تجيب السؤال أو تصدق الخبر، ولا النعمة بمعنى العطاء.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نعم ضد بئس (maqayis)؛ نعم وبئس فعلان ماضيان ... فنعم مدح وبئس ذم (sihah)؛ نعما ... المعنى نعم الشيء هي (tahdhib)؛ نعم كلمة تستعمل في المدح بإزاء بئس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi olumlu cevap, söyleneni doğrulama ve geleceğe dönük söz verme işlevlerini aynı cevap kolunda açıkça birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu cevap işlevi övgü bildiren eş biçimli koldan ve genel doğruluk inancından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek başına kullanılan olumlu cevap ile birine olumlu cevap verme yapısı korunur, övgü anlamı içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir soruya olumlu cevap vermek, söylenen bir şeyi doğru diye onaylamak veya istenen bir iş için olumlu söz vermektir.

facets.statement: Soruya veya önermeye olumlu cevap verip onu doğrulama.
Gelecekte yapılacak bir iş için olumlu söz veya güvence verme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, bu cevap sözünün olumsuz cevabın karşıtı olduğunu ve soru yanıtlama, doğrulama ve söz verme işlevlerinde kullanıldığını ortak biçimde gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: evet diyerek onaylamak veya söz vermek
concept_gloss.applicability: Olumlu cevap, doğrulama ve olumlu güvence verme işlevlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu yanıtlama, doğrulama ve söz verme işlevlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumlu cevap verilen veya bir önermenin doğrulandığı konuşmalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu cevap ve doğrulama işlevini doğrudan korur.
error_profile.loses: Gelecekte yapılacak iş için açıkça söz verme yönünü zorunlu olarak göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir isteğe olumlu karşılık verilip geleceğe dönük güvence sunulduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu söz ve işi yapma güvencesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir önermeyi yalnızca doğru diye onaylama işlevini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Soru yanıtlamanın yanında olumlu söz ve güvence verme işlevini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle geleceğe ilişkin bir bildirimi doğru diye kabul eden cevap sözüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da konuşmada söyleneni doğru sayan olumlu cevap verir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol doğrulayıcı cevapta yoğunlaşır; bu kol ise genel olumlu yanıtın yanında söz verme işlevine de sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Olumlu soruyu veya bildirimi onaylar ve gerektiğinde söz verme işlevi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Olumsuz kurulmuş sözü geri çevirerek karşıt olumlu hükmü doğrular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da konuşmada olumlu hüküm kuran kısa cevap sözleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol genel onay ve olumlu yanıt verir; komşu kol özellikle önceki olumsuzluğu bozup tersini doğrular.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların hepsi değerlendirildi; genel olumlu cevap ile doğrulayıcı ve olumsuzluğu bozan cevap türleri arasındaki iki sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نعم حرفا أو كلمة جواب، للتصديق والإيجاب والعدة، وما اتصل بذلك مثل أنعم له أي قال له نعم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه نعم المدحية المقابلة لبئس، ولا النعمة بمعنى الإحسان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نعم جواب الواجب ضد لا (maqayis)؛ نعم عدة وتصديق وجواب الاستفهام (sihah)؛ نعم يكون تصديقا ويكون عدة (tahdhib)؛ نعم كلمة للإيجاب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tekil kullanımın özellikle develeri gösterdiğini, çoğul kapsamın ise deve, sığır ve koyun gibi otlayan evcil hayvanlara genişlediğini belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deveye özgü dar kapsam ile daha geniş otlayan evcil hayvan topluluğu aynı düzeyde genellenmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hayvan adlarını kapsar ve başka kollardaki kuş ya da bağış anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Dar kullanımda develeri, daha geniş topluluk adında ise deve, sığır ve koyun gibi otlayan evcil hayvanları gösteren hayvan varlığıdır.

facets.statement: Dar ve belirgin kullanımda develer veya deve malı.
Geniş topluluk adında deve, sığır ve koyunu kapsayan otlayan evcil hayvanlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, dar adın deveye özgü veya ağırlıklı olduğunu; geniş adın ise deve, sığır ve koyunla birlikte otlayan evcil hayvanları kapsadığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: develer ve geniş anlamda otlayan evcil hayvanlar
concept_gloss.applicability: Deveye özgü dar kullanım ile daha geniş hayvan topluluğu kullanımını ayırarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Deve odağını ve deve, sığır, koyuna genişleyen topluluk kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dar adın özellikle deve varlığını gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dar kapsamdaki deveye özgü hayvan adını korur.
error_profile.loses: Geniş adın sığır ve koyunu da kapsayan topluluk yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve, sığır ve koyunun birlikte kapsandığı geniş kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş topluluk kapsamını ve hayvanların otlayan evcil türler oluşunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Bağlam sınırlandırılmazsa kaynak kapsamı dışındaki başka otlayan evcil türleri de düşündürebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Geniş kullanımda sığır ve koyunu da deveyle aynı hayvan topluluğuna katar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ergin erkek deveyi, devenin eşini ve develerin sahipleriyle birlikte oluşturduğu sürüyü ayrıntılandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da develeri ve deve varlığını doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol dar adla deveyi, geniş adla birkaç evcil hayvan türünü kapsar; komşu kol devenin cinsiyet, erginlik ve sürü ayrıntılarına odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deveyi merkez alır ve geniş kullanımda sığır ile koyunu birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnız koyun ve keçi türünden küçükbaş hayvan topluluğunu cinsiyet ayrımı yapmadan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol evcil ve otlayan hayvanların topluluk adları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol deve merkezli olup daha geniş bir tür dizisine açılır; komşu kol küçükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar tarandı; deve merkezli dar kapsam ile sürü ve küçükbaş topluluğu arasındaki iki karşılaştırma sınırı en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النعم والأنعام، خصوصا الإبل، وبالتوسيع الإبل والبقر والغنم والبهائم الراعية حيث نصت المصادر على ذلك.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النعمة بمعنى العطاء، ولا النعام الطائر، ولا النعامة المشبهة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النعم الإبل لما فيه من الخير والنعمة والأنعام البهائم (maqayis)؛ النعم واحد الأنعام وهي المال الراعية وأكثر ما يقع هذا الاسم على الإبل (sihah)؛ النعم لم يريدوا بها إلا الإبل فإذا قالوا الأنعام أرادوا بها الإبل والبقر والغنم (tahdhib)؛ النعم مختص بالإبل وجمعه أنعام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kuş türünde birleşir; ancak tekil ve topluluk adlarının erkek, dişi veya türün bütünü için kullanılışı konusunda kapsam farkı bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tür kimliği sabittir, fakat tekil biçimin cinsiyet kapsamı kaynaklardaki farklı kullanımlara göre belirtilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan kuş türüne aittir; benzetmeyle adlandırılan nesneler ve deyimler bu kola katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Devekuşu türüdür; kullanılan biçime ve kaynağa göre türün bütünü, erkek veya dişi birey gösterilebilir.

facets.statement: Doğrudan devekuşu türü ve bu türün bireyi.
Tekil ve topluluk adlarının erkek, dişi veya tür geneli için kullanılabilmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt kuş türünde birleşir; ayrım, tekil ve topluluk biçimlerinin tür geneli ile erkek veya dişi bireye nasıl dağıtıldığı noktadadır.

concept_gloss.text: devekuşu
concept_gloss.applicability: Kuş türünün kendisini karşılar; cinsiyet ayrımı gerektiğinde bağlamla belirlenir.

error_profile.preserves: Tür kimliğini korur ve tek başına zorunlu bir cinsiyet ayrımı eklemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir cinsiyetten çok kuş türünün bütünü kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuşun tür kimliğini açık ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bazı kullanımlardaki özel erkek veya dişi birey ayrımını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlı kuş türünü ve onun erkek ya da dişi bireylerini doğrudan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuşa benzetilerek aynı adın verildiği nesne, beden bölümü, yol ve gök konumlarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Komşu koldaki aktarmalı adlandırmaların benzetme kaynağı bu kuşun görünüşüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol gerçek kuşu adlandırır; komşu kol kuşun görünüşünden hareketle başka varlıklara aktarılmış adları toplar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Türü veya tek bir erkek ya da dişi bireyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir arada bulunan devekuşlarının oluşturduğu sürüyü özel bir topluluk adıyla gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kolun canlı katılımcısı aynı kuş türüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol tür ve birey düzeyindedir; komşu kol ise yalnız birden çok bireyin oluşturduğu sürü düzeyindedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm aday kuş ve kuşla ilişkili adlar değerlendirildi; gerçek türü aktarmalı adlardan ve sürü adından ayıran iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النعامة والنعام للطائر المعروف، ذكرا أو أنثى، وما يذكر من جنسه وصفاته المباشرة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النعم الإبل، ولا الأجسام أو الأمثال المسماة نعامة بالتشبيه إلا إذا كان الطائر نفسه مقصودا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النعامة معروفة لنعمة ريشها (maqayis)؛ النعامة من الطير يذكر ويؤنث والنعام اسم جنس (sihah)؛ النعام الظليم والنعامة الأنثى (tahdhib)؛ النعامة سميت تشبيها بالنعم في الخلقة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi devekuşuna benzetilerek aynı adın verildiği çeşitli varlıkları destekler; bunlar tek bir nesne türü değil, ortak adlandırma yoluyla bağlı bir kümedir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Benzetme ilişkisi korunmalı, listedeki nesnelerden bağımsız ve üretken bir genel anlam çıkarılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin aktarmalı adları tanımlanır; gerçek kuş ve kuşlu deyimler bu kapsama alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Devekuşunun görünüşüne veya belirgin bir özelliğine benzetilerek aynı adın verildiği kuyu kirişi, dağ gölgeliği, ayak ya da bacak bölümü, yol ve Ay'ın konak yerleri gibi varlıklardır.

facets.statement: Devekuşuna benzerlik yoluyla başka bir varlığa aktarılan ad.
Kuyu kirişi, dağ gölgeliği, ayak veya bacak bölümü ve yol için kullanılan aktarmalı adlar.
Ay'ın konak yerlerinden biri veya bu adla anılan yıldız kümesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, kuşun görünüşünden doğan ad aktarımını kuyu ve dağ yapıları, beden bölümleri, yol ve gök konumu gibi farklı somut örneklerle gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: devekuşuna benzetilerek ad verilen şeyler
concept_gloss.applicability: Ortak benzetme kaynağını koruyarak farklı aktarmalı adların tümüne uygulanır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçek kuştan başka varlıklara yapılan ad aktarımını ve örnek çeşitliliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuyu, dağ, beden veya yol üzerindeki somut benzetme açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görünüş benzerliğine dayalı somut ad aktarımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ay'ın konak yeri olarak kullanılan özel gökbilim adını açıkça kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: devekuşuna benzetilen kuyu kirişi, gölgelik, beden bölümü veya yol

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kuşun adıyla anılan kuyu, dağ, beden, yol ve gök konumu gibi aktarmalı varlıkları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Canlı devekuşu türünü ve onun bireylerini doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aktarmalı adların ortak benzetme kaynağı komşu koldaki gerçek kuştur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol benzerlik yoluyla başka varlıklara verilen adlardan oluşur; komşu kol ise benzetme kaynağı olan canlı türün kendisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ad aktarımında kaynak görüntü olarak devekuşunu kullanır ve gök konumuna kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ad aktarımında kaynak görüntü olarak böbreğin biçimini kullanır ve kap, yay ile bulut parçalarına yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol bir varlığın görünüşünü başka nesnelere ad olarak aktarma yolunu kullanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Adlandırma yöntemi benzerdir, fakat benzetme kaynağı ve ad verilen nesneler bütünüyle ayrıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; gerçek kuşla sınır ve başka bir benzetmeli ad kümesiyle yöntem farkı en yararlı iki karşılaştırmadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المسميات المشبهة بالنعامة في الهيئة أو البعد أو السرعة، مثل خشبة البئر والظلة على رأس الجبل وباطن القدم أو عرق الرجل أو الساق والمحجة والنعائم من منازل القمر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الطائر نفسه، ولا الإبل والأنعام، ولا نعم الجواب والمدح.
branches.source_phrase_ar: على معنى التشبيه النعامة وهي كالظلة تجعل على رءوس الجبل (maqayis)؛ النعامة الخشبة المعترضة على الزرنوقين والنعائم منزل من منازل القمر (sihah)؛ النعامة الخشبة المعترضة على الزرنوقين وابن النعامة عرق الرجل ومحجة الطريق (tahdhib)؛ النعامة المظلة في الجبل وعلى رأس البئر تشبيها بالنعامة في الهيئة والنعائم من منازل القمر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kuş imgeli sözlerin topluluğun dağılması, hızla ayrılması, yol alması, birliğini ya da gücünü yitirmesi için kullanıldığını destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen söz kalıplarına aittir; kuşun tek başına taşıdığı yalın bir dağılma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kanıtlanan söz kalıplarına bağlanır ve yalın kuş adına dağılma ya da yenilme anlamı yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kuş imgeli sözlerde bir topluluğun hızla dağılıp ayrılması, yol alması veya birliğini ya da gücünü yitirmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun bir arada kalamayarak dağılıp ayrılması veya yola çıkması.
Topluluğun ortak sözünü, gücünü veya saygınlığını yitirmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, kalıplaşmış kuş imgesini toplu ayrılma ve dağılma çekirdeğine bağlar; hızla yol alma, ortaklığın bozulması ve güç kaybı bu çekirdeğin bağlamsal sonuçlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bir topluluğun dağılıp gücünü yitirmesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtlanan kuş imgeli sözlerdeki dağılma, ayrılma ve güç kaybı alanını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toplu dağılmayı, ayrılmayı ve buna bağlı güç kaybını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun birliğini kaybedip farklı yönlere ayrıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun dağılması ve ortaklığının bozulması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Hızlı yol alma kullanımını zorunlu olarak belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dağılmanın yanında ayrılma, hızla yol alma ve güç kaybı sonuçlarını taşıyabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle insanların birbirinden farklı yönlere saçılmasını tek bir tarihsel benzetmeyle anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir topluluğun birlikten çıkıp farklı yönlere dağılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol yönlere saçılma üzerinde yoğunlaşır; bu kol ise belirli kuş imgeli yapılarda ayrılma ve güç kaybını da kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; farklı yönlere dağılma karşılaştırması kalıbın ayrılma ve güç kaybı sınırını açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه شالت نعامتهم وخفت نعامتهم وأضحوا نعاما ونحوها، حيث يدل التعبير على الارتحال أو التفرق أو ذهاب العز أو الهزيمة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النعامة الطائر إذا لم تكن في مثل أو كناية، ولا أسماء الأجسام المسماة نعامة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: شالت نعامتهم إذا تفرقوا (maqayis)؛ للقوم إذا ارتحلوا أو تفرقوا قد شالت نعامتهم (sihah)؛ خفت نعامتهم أي استمر بهم السير وشالت نعامتهم إذا تفرقت كلمتهم أو ذهب عزهم (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı güneyden esen, yumuşak, nemli ve öteki rüzgarlara göre daha ıslak bir yel için ortak biçimde kullanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yumuşak esiş tek başına yeterli değildir; güney yönü ve nemlilik bu kolun belirleyici sınırlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın rüzgar adına aittir ve genel yumuşaklık ya da kuş anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Güneyden esen, esişi yumuşak ve taşıdığı hava nemli olan rüzgardır.

facets.statement: Güney yönünden esen belirli bir rüzgar.
Esişi yumuşak, havası nemli ve ıslaklık taşıyan rüzgar niteliği.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt rüzgarın güney yönünü, yumuşak esişini ve belirgin nemliliğini aynı hava olayı içinde birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir şeyi bilme ve gerçeğiyle kavramadır; bildirme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında yenme ayrı biçimlere bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bütün işaret türlerini sınırsızca kapsamaz; kaynakta anılan ayırt etme ve yol gösterme işlevli izlerle bunlara bağlı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

Birinin üst dudağını yarmak, anatomik sonucun oluşturulmasını bildiren eylemsel kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık iki karşılığı yan yana verir: bir aktarım sözcüğü deniz olarak açıklar, öteki tanıklıklar ise suyu bol kuyu anlamını destekler. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claim kimlikleri bulunmadığı için bu karşıtlık ortak özet içinde, atıf uydurulmadan korunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımlarının ortak işlemi, birini ya da bir şeyi yöneldiği veya istediği şeyden alıkoyup geri çevirmektir. Haksızlığı ve bozulmayı önleme ile düzeltme amacı bu işlemin güçlü bir gerekçesidir, ancak bütün tanıklıklarda zorunlu koşul olarak belirtilmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı bilgiyi, anlayışı, ağırbaşlılığı ve doğruyu bilgi ile us yoluyla bulmayı tek bir yetkinlik alanında birleştirir. Bu alan salt bilgi sahibi olmaktan daha güçlü, yargılama ya da teknik ustalıktan ise farklıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gevşeklik, eksik veya kuşku taşımayacak ölçüde sağlam ve kusursuz duruma getirmek ya da onun böyle bir duruma yerleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin yapısı veya düzeni sağlamlaştırılır ve kusur barındırmayacak biçimde tamamlanır.

Bir söz veya metin, kuşkuya ve karışıklığa yer bırakmayacak açıklıkta düzenlenmiş olabilir.
Bir kişinin övgüye değer niteliğinde en ileri düzeye varması, sağlamlaşmanın kişiye uygulanmış özel bir anlatımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyi sağlamlaştırma, onun bu durumda yerleşmesi ve kuşku ya da eksik barındırmayan bir bütünlük kazanması çevresinde birleşir.
